# `account_review_sweep`

Area: **worker** ([all tables](README.md))

The last full sweep of the per-account passes (one row): a later business date or other settings start a new one.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `boolean` | no | `true` | Always true: the table holds one row. |
| `swept_on` | `date` | no |  | Business date (BILLING_TZ) of the last full sweep. |
| `settings` | `text` | no |  | The lifecycle and notification settings that sweep used, as text; a difference means a full sweep. |
